dogecoin.text: @dogecode1 @enjin Hey there, we're sorry to hear you're experiencing issues. We are deploying a new wallet update in the next day or so that will allow you to replace pending Dogecoin transactions. Please stay tuned for that update and we hope you consider continuing to use our wallet!

🆕We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear.

The latest Enjin Wallet update allows you to cancel pending #Bitcoin, #Litecoin, and #Dogecoin transactions ⌛️

Learn more about how to handle pending transactions and select an optimal sending fee: https://t.co/3vXVFa8Q39 https://t.co/DhBhtgxWyr
